title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. What do Ulama say about the following masail? An organization collects Zakat and spends it in bellow activities. 1) Organizes big conferences and exhibitions 2) Runs satellite TV channel and casts programmes on it 3) Produces CDs and DVDs of the programmes 4) Spends on organization?s website 5) Uses it for traveling expenditure of its heads and others 6) Runs an English medium school 7) Qur?an distribution among the non-Muslims Note: monthly fees of the school where Zakat amount is spent is e.g. around ten thousand but a student cannot afford for whole sum of fees then the school takes five thousand from the student and completes the rest from the Zakat. Please answer these masail in the light of Qur?an and Sunnah of the Prophet (saw) that one can pay the sum of Zakat to this sort of organization or not. If not then what does Shariah speak about the Zakat of a person who had already paid to the organization? 2409 views Q. Zakat On Savings for some purpose 1738 views Q. Giving zakah money to one's sister 2304 views Q. Zakat on land 1771 views Q. Can a father give his zakah to his son? 3726 views Q. Zakat 1858 views Q. Assalamlikum 1) Please provide me a fatwa regarding my plot (land) Zakath. I have a small plot present value less than Rs.3 lakhs. This plot I keep for my daughter's marriage expenses now she is small. So, in this case I have to pay zakath on this plot value or not. Please provide me the FATWA under Islamic law. Thanks & regards! 1768 views Q. Early Zakat (Before it's due date) 2302 views Q. Reconsider my intention of Charity(Satka) to Zakat. 2823 views Q. I found some money (1 note of Bangladeshi 500 Taka, equivalent to US $7) at the Masjid premise (that leads to the entrance/exit of the Masjid and Madrasa), on January 18, 2008. Instantly I enquired to few people like Muazzin, Khadem of Masjid and some labours whether they lost any money. They said 'NO'. I thought it was lost from any worker (Madrasa-construction work was going on ) and hence enquired my best but found no one claiming the money. Then I requested the Muazzin to make a decleration after Isha Farz Salaah among the Musallis regarding the lost money. He did so. But no one came or claimed. Then I asked a local Ulama regarding the matter and he replied, I should wait for 2 months. If in the mean time no one came to claim the money, I should give the money to poor people. 1 (one) month has already passed. I'm confused about what to do with that note. Please provide me answers for the following queries on the basis of the written matter: 1). Should I really wait for another 1 month (total 2 months) to find the owner of the money? 2). What other types of decleration should I make to find the owner? Should I make some posters and paste them on the Masjid building? 3). If I can give the money to the poor right now, waiting no further, Should I give all the money to a single poor man/woman or I can give among 50 people at same or more & less proportionate. 4). If someone asks me for a loan of 500 Taka, Can I give him that note of 500 Taka since it's in my pocket for long 1 month without being used , finding no owner? Inshallah I can give the same amount if the real owner claims the money after I give the money to someone as loan. Please, read carefully and provide all the necessary and possible annwers with available options I have. ZazakAllah 1612 views Q. Charity 1488 views Q. Am I doing right or doing biddah 1432 views Q. CAN I GIVE ZAQAT TO OTHER THAN MUSLIMS? 1818 views Q. My name is Mustafa. Every Ramadan I calculate my zakah. But this time I invested some money in Mutual Fund. Should I calculate invested money, so how to calculate my zakah. 2416 views Q. Payment of Zakat 2246 views

Secondly pls inform we use in our buisness Runnning Finanace and Trust Receipt from a banking company. Question: How we can distribute Zakat? Whether deposit it Pakistan Government account or inditually. Secondly pls inform we use in our buisness Runnning Finanace and Trust Receipt from a banking company. Answer ID: 2151 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1926/1475=H) It is advisable for you to deliver your zakah yourself to the poor and give it in their possession. And, if you are satisfied that the government spends the zakah on poor by giving it in their possession then it is allowable to deposit it in the account. (2) We could not understand this matter well; please ask this question again clearly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
